description: This Java source file defines the ContactsFragment class, an Android Fragment that demonstrates accessing and modifying the device's contacts content provider. It includes functionality to display the first contact, load contacts, and insert a dummy contact, illustrating runtime permissions handling for contacts.

classes.name: ContactsFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays contacts and allows inserting a dummy contact, used within a sample app to demonstrate runtime permission handling and content provider access for contacts.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ContactsFragment.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, sets up button click listeners to load contacts and insert dummy contact.

methods.name: loadContact
methods.description: Restarts the loader to query the contacts content provider.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates a CursorLoader to query contacts content provider for contact IDs and names.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Handles the result of the contact query, displaying the first contact and total count.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Resets the loader state, updating UI accordingly.

methods.name: insertDummyContact
methods.description: Inserts a dummy contact with a placeholder name into the contacts provider.
